plans.subject: [SIMULATED / NOT SENT] Lavish SERENITY — A Story in Layers
plans.body:

IMPORTANT MEDIA DISTINCTION: The matching 15-second 1080x1920 concept MP4/poster have NOT been produced or supplied. A separate 10.08-second, 720x960 user-provided SERENITY preview is available through the presentation-assets sidecar; it is not this script-matched concept video and is not generated live. The future event protocol includes a counterfactual media/delivery completion for replay only, not a statement of actual file availability or transmission.

Review requested: brand tone; product claim accuracy; Arabic copy; final visual and music rights; script-to-film alignment before public use.

This message is a never-sent fixture using .invalid recipients. No social, email or video-generation service was contacted.
